newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to auction eight bln rupees bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to auction eight bln rupees bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Friday it invited tenders by Monday for the auction of six-month Short-Term Federal Bonds worth eight billion rupees.
Tenders will be opened on Monday and results will be announced on Tuesday, it said.
Successful bidders will be required to deposit the amount of accepted bids on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
"Bids can be rejected without assigning any reason," he said.
